description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the Table of Contents feature in the Daux documentation generator, specifically testing the HTML output generated from Markdown content with various TOC configurations.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A stub engine class that simulates rendering logic by returning the content directly.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A custom template class that overrides the getEngine method to return the Engine class.

classes.name: TableOfContentsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the Table of Contents feature in Markdown to HTML conversion.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Sets up and returns a configuration array with a custom template renderer.

methods.name: testNoTOCByDefault
methods.description: Tests that no Table of Contents is generated when the auto_toc option is not enabled.

methods.name: testShouldAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOn
methods.description: Verifies that a TOC is added when the auto_toc option is enabled.

methods.name: testShouldNotAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOnAndTOCisPresent
methods.description: Ensures no additional TOC is added if a [TOC] token is already present in the content.

methods.name: testTOCToken
methods.description: Checks that a [TOC] token correctly generates a TOC in the HTML output.

methods.name: testUnicodeTOC
methods.description: Tests the TOC generation with Unicode (non-ASCII) headers.

methods.name: testDuplicatedTOC
methods.description: Tests the behavior when multiple headers with the same name appear, verifying unique ID generation.

methods.name: testEscapedTOC
methods.description: Validates that special characters in headers are properly escaped and converted into valid HTML IDs.

methods.name: testQuotesWorkCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures that quotes within headers are handled correctly, with a note that this test requires PHP versions less than 8.1.
